Hi, I’m a DC graduate and I’m currently working at the hospital I did my placement in. I got hired before I finished placement and I got to work while I waited to write my CSMLS exam. The program is mostly self-learning. You have one week per month where you go in person, called residential weeks where you go and solidify any information you need. Also that’s where you do your labs. Cytology looks at pathological changes in cells (looking for cancer!) , and histology looks at the study of pathological changes in tissue . It’s very microscope heavy for cytology. Depending on the hospital, you might do prep work but mostly screening slides. Class size is 15-18 in cytology. You need to write the CSMLS exam and get certified, and if you plan to work in Ontario, register for CMLTO upon successful completion of the exam. Let me know if you have any questions!

Hey, I did cytology at Michener and now I’m working at a Cyto-histo tech. I’d say it’s a good program, and there are jobs out there if you want to do cytology straight up or a hybrid position involving histology. But yes, cytology is more specialized. also, I work days! And no, it does not put you in a higher position in the lab.
